name: crew-hq
description: Crew HQ: an AI team inside Claude Code, plus a live cost cockpit, a done chime and a destructive-command seatbelt.

plugins.name: crew-hq
plugins.description: HQ pane over every project's TASKS.md + a crew of five subagents that pick up @claude tasks, huddle, and report back

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Live cost, context and rate-limit gauges, tool activity and what Claude is doing right now

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: Chime + summary toast when a long task finishes

plugins.name: seatbelt
plugins.description: Blocks rm -rf, force pushes, hard resets, table drops and .env edits before they run
